title: Deliver Oil to Sunford Oil Refinery
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Oil** delivered to **Sunford Oil Refinery** (industry id 4, near tile 78,27).

A likely supplier is **Manford Oil Wells** (industry id 14, near tile 86,45); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **570 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
